# A start or limit that names a constant keeps the name in the emitted code, since
# the file is compiled for every build and the constant can have another value in
# another one. Here width differs by GOARCH: written out as its value on one
# architecture, the vector loop would stop short, or run past the slices, on the
# others. A constant written with literals alone is spelled as its value.

exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

loopvec -split .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops_simd.go ops_simd.go.want

env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- width_amd64.go --
package test

const width = 32
-- width_arm64.go --
package test

const width = 64
-- width_other.go --
//go:build !amd64 && !arm64

package test

const width = 48
-- width.go --
package test

// Width is width, for testmain to check against.
func Width() int { return width }
-- ops.go --
package test

func Add(dst, a, b []float32) {
	for i := 0; i < width; i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i] + b[i]
	}
}

func AddInclusive(dst, a, b []float32) {
	for i := 0; i <= width-1; i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i] + b[i]
	}
}

func AddDown(dst, a, b []float32) {
	for i := width - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
		dst[i] = a[i] + b[i]
	}
}

func AddAbove(dst, a, b []float32) {
	for i := len(dst) - 1; i > width; i-- {
		dst[i] = a[i] + b[i]
	}
}

func AddLiteral(dst, a, b []float32) {
	for i := 0; i < 2*8; i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i] + b[i]
	}
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import (
	"simd"
	"unsafe"
)

func Add(dst, a, b []float32) {
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, a, 0, width, 0, width) || _loopvecOverlap(dst, b, 0, width, 0, width) {
		for i := 0; i < width; i++ {
			dst[i] = a[i] + b[i]
		}
	} else {
		_ = dst[width-1]
		_ = a[width-1]
		_ = b[width-1]
		{
			_w1 := dst[:width:width]
			_count := len(_w1)
			_w2, _w3 := a[:_count:_count], b[:_count:_count]
			_i, _lanes := 0, simd.BroadcastFloat32s(0).Len()
			for ; _i <= _count-4*_lanes; _i += 4 * _lanes {
				_c1, _c2, _c3 := _w1[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w2[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w3[_i:][:4*_lanes]
				_v1 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c2)
				_v2 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c3)
				_v1.Add(_v2).Store(_c1)
				_v3 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c2[_lanes:])
				_v4 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c3[_lanes:])
				_v3.Add(_v4).Store(_c1[_lanes:])
				_v5 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c2[2*_lanes:])
				_v6 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c3[2*_lanes:])
				_v5.Add(_v6).Store(_c1[2*_lanes:])
				_v7 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c2[3*_lanes:])
				_v8 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c3[3*_lanes:])
				_v7.Add(_v8).Store(_c1[3*_lanes:])
			}
			for ; _i <= _count-_lanes; _i += _lanes {
				_v9 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_w2[_i:])
				_v10 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_w3[_i:])
				_v9.Add(_v10).Store(_w1[_i:])
			}
			for _i < _count {
				_v11, _n := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(_w2[_i:])
				_v12, _ := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(_w3[_i:])
				_v11.Add(_v12).StorePart(_w1[_i:])
				_i += _n
			}
		}
	}
}

func AddInclusive(dst, a, b []float32) {
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, a, 0, width, 0, width) || _loopvecOverlap(dst, b, 0, width, 0, width) {
		for i := 0; i <= width-1; i++ {
			dst[i] = a[i] + b[i]
		}
	} else {
		_ = dst[width-1]
		_ = a[width-1]
		_ = b[width-1]
		{
			_w1 := dst[:width:width]
			_count := len(_w1)
			_w2, _w3 := a[:_count:_count], b[:_count:_count]
			_i, _lanes := 0, simd.BroadcastFloat32s(0).Len()
			for ; _i <= _count-4*_lanes; _i += 4 * _lanes {
				_c1, _c2, _c3 := _w1[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w2[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w3[_i:][:4*_lanes]
				_v1 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c2)
				_v2 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c3)
				_v1.Add(_v2).Store(_c1)
				_v3 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c2[_lanes:])
				_v4 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c3[_lanes:])
				_v3.Add(_v4).Store(_c1[_lanes:])
				_v5 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c2[2*_lanes:])
				_v6 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c3[2*_lanes:])
				_v5.Add(_v6).Store(_c1[2*_lanes:])
				_v7 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c2[3*_lanes:])
				_v8 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c3[3*_lanes:])
				_v7.Add(_v8).Store(_c1[3*_lanes:])
			}
			for ; _i <= _count-_lanes; _i += _lanes {
				_v9 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_w2[_i:])
				_v10 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_w3[_i:])
				_v9.Add(_v10).Store(_w1[_i:])
			}
			for _i < _count {
				_v11, _n := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(_w2[_i:])
				_v12, _ := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(_w3[_i:])
				_v11.Add(_v12).StorePart(_w1[_i:])
				_i += _n
			}
		}
	}
}

func AddDown(dst, a, b []float32) {
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, a, 0, width, 0, width) || _loopvecOverlap(dst, b, 0, width, 0, width) {
		for i := width - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
			dst[i] = a[i] + b[i]
		}
	} else {
		_ = dst[width-1]
		_ = a[width-1]
		_ = b[width-1]
		{
			_w1 := dst[:width:width]
			_count := len(_w1)
			_w2, _w3 := a[:_count:_count], b[:_count:_count]
			_i, _lanes := 0, simd.BroadcastFloat32s(0).Len()
			for ; _i <= _count-4*_lanes; _i += 4 * _lanes {
				_c1, _c2, _c3 := _w1[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w2[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w3[_i:][:4*_lanes]
				_v1 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c2)
				_v2 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c3)
				_v1.Add(_v2).Store(_c1)
				_v3 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c2[_lanes:])
				_v4 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c3[_lanes:])
				_v3.Add(_v4).Store(_c1[_lanes:])
				_v5 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c2[2*_lanes:])
				_v6 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c3[2*_lanes:])
				_v5.Add(_v6).Store(_c1[2*_lanes:])
				_v7 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c2[3*_lanes:])
				_v8 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c3[3*_lanes:])
				_v7.Add(_v8).Store(_c1[3*_lanes:])
			}
			for ; _i <= _count-_lanes; _i += _lanes {
				_v9 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_w2[_i:])
				_v10 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_w3[_i:])
				_v9.Add(_v10).Store(_w1[_i:])
			}
			for _i < _count {
				_v11, _n := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(_w2[_i:])
				_v12, _ := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(_w3[_i:])
				_v11.Add(_v12).StorePart(_w1[_i:])
				_i += _n
			}
		}
	}
}

func AddAbove(dst, a, b []float32) {
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, a, width+1, len(dst), width+1, len(dst)) || _loopvecOverlap(dst, b, width+1, len(dst), width+1, len(dst)) {
		for i := len(dst) - 1; i > width; i-- {
			dst[i] = a[i] + b[i]
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > width+1 {
			_ = a[len(dst)-1]
			_ = b[len(dst)-1]
			{
				_w1 := dst[width+1:][:(len(dst) - (width + 1)):(len(dst) - (width + 1))]
				_count := len(_w1)
				_w2, _w3 := a[width+1:][:_count:_count], b[width+1:][:_count:_count]
				_i, _lanes := 0, simd.BroadcastFloat32s(0).Len()
				for ; _i <= _count-4*_lanes; _i += 4 * _lanes {
					_c1, _c2, _c3 := _w1[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w2[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w3[_i:][:4*_lanes]
					_v1 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c2)
					_v2 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c3)
					_v1.Add(_v2).Store(_c1)
					_v3 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c2[_lanes:])
					_v4 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c3[_lanes:])
					_v3.Add(_v4).Store(_c1[_lanes:])
					_v5 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c2[2*_lanes:])
					_v6 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c3[2*_lanes:])
					_v5.Add(_v6).Store(_c1[2*_lanes:])
					_v7 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c2[3*_lanes:])
					_v8 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c3[3*_lanes:])
					_v7.Add(_v8).Store(_c1[3*_lanes:])
				}
				for ; _i <= _count-_lanes; _i += _lanes {
					_v9 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_w2[_i:])
					_v10 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_w3[_i:])
					_v9.Add(_v10).Store(_w1[_i:])
				}
				for _i < _count {
					_v11, _n := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(_w2[_i:])
					_v12, _ := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(_w3[_i:])
					_v11.Add(_v12).StorePart(_w1[_i:])
					_i += _n
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

func AddLiteral(dst, a, b []float32) {
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, a, 0, 16, 0, 16) || _loopvecOverlap(dst, b, 0, 16, 0, 16) {
		for i := 0; i < 2*8; i++ {
			dst[i] = a[i] + b[i]
		}
	} else {
		_ = dst[16-1]
		_ = a[16-1]
		_ = b[16-1]
		{
			_w1 := dst[:16:16]
			_count := len(_w1)
			_w2, _w3 := a[:_count:_count], b[:_count:_count]
			_i, _lanes := 0, simd.BroadcastFloat32s(0).Len()
			for ; _i <= _count-4*_lanes; _i += 4 * _lanes {
				_c1, _c2, _c3 := _w1[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w2[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w3[_i:][:4*_lanes]
				_v1 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c2)
				_v2 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c3)
				_v1.Add(_v2).Store(_c1)
				_v3 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c2[_lanes:])
				_v4 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c3[_lanes:])
				_v3.Add(_v4).Store(_c1[_lanes:])
				_v5 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c2[2*_lanes:])
				_v6 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c3[2*_lanes:])
				_v5.Add(_v6).Store(_c1[2*_lanes:])
				_v7 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c2[3*_lanes:])
				_v8 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c3[3*_lanes:])
				_v7.Add(_v8).Store(_c1[3*_lanes:])
			}
			for ; _i <= _count-_lanes; _i += _lanes {
				_v9 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_w2[_i:])
				_v10 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_w3[_i:])
				_v9.Add(_v10).Store(_w1[_i:])
			}
			for _i < _count {
				_v11, _n := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(_w2[_i:])
				_v12, _ := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(_w3[_i:])
				_v11.Add(_v12).StorePart(_w1[_i:])
				_i += _n
			}
		}
	}
}

func _loopvecOverlap[T any](a, b []T, aLo, aHi, bLo, bHi int) bool {
	if aLo >= aHi || bLo >= bHi {
		return false
	}
	size := unsafe.Sizeof(a[0])
	aBase := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(a)))
	bBase := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(b)))
	return aBase+uintptr(aLo)*size < bBase+uintptr(bHi)*size && bBase+uintptr(bLo)*size < aBase+uintptr(aHi)*size
}
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 5 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
-- testmain/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/test"
)

const n = 100

// check reports whether f stored a[i] + b[i] at exactly the indexes lo..hi-1 of
// dst and left every other element alone.
func check(f func(dst, a, b []float32), lo, hi int) bool {
	dst, a, b := make([]float32, n), make([]float32, n), make([]float32, n)
	for i := range a {
		a[i], b[i], dst[i] = float32(i), float32(2*i), -1
	}
	f(dst, a, b)
	for i := range dst {
		want := float32(-1)
		if lo <= i && i < hi {
			want = a[i] + b[i]
		}
		if dst[i] != want {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func main() {
	w := test.Width()
	fmt.Println(check(test.Add, 0, w))
	fmt.Println(check(test.AddInclusive, 0, w))
	fmt.Println(check(test.AddDown, 0, w))
	fmt.Println(check(test.AddAbove, w+1, n))
	fmt.Println(check(test.AddLiteral, 0, 16))
}
-- testmain/output --
true
true
true
true
true
